title: Format: cinematic 16:9 animated comedy, 30 seconds, high-quality stylized 2D…
content:
Format: cinematic 16:9 animated comedy, 30 seconds, high-quality stylized 2D animation with dimensional lighting and fluid facial animation. Preserve the exact face, body type, proportions, hairstyle, costume, colors, accessories and personality of every character from the ten reference images. Unify the rendering style without redesigning any character.

Location: a small, suspiciously immaculate community garden belonging to the ex-mafia wannabe gardener. A long wooden table runs horizontally across the middle of the garden. A greenhouse stands on the far left, the entrance gate is centered in the background, and yellow flower beds fill the right side.

Fixed spatial positions
Shy Japanese girl: far left, beside the end of the table.
Duras Dacicus: left background, behind the table.
Officer Lin: center-left, behind a bamboo dumpling steamer.
Grumpy Cat: sitting directly in the center of the table.
Nae: center-right, facing Officer Lin.
Lady Florentine and Madame Gogo Chanel: seated together on the right side of the table.
Big Good Wolf: standing behind the two women on the right.
Ex-mafia gardener: far right, beside his yellow flowers.
Zaches: initially concealed near the background gate.

Nobody changes sides between shots. Maintain consistent screen direction and garden geography throughout.

Audio: no music and no narrator. Only dialogue, garden ambience and precisely timed sound effects. Native-language dialogue must have natural pronunciation and accurate lip synchronization. Do not generate subtitles or other on-screen text; leave clean lower-frame space for subtitles to be added later.

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:03

Camera: wide establishing shot from slightly above the garden gate, slowly craning downward toward the long table.

All ten characters are visible in their established positions. The gardener stands proudly beside his flowers with his hands in his orange jacket pockets. Everyone else looks uncertain about why they have been invited.

The gardener announces in English, with forced respectability:

EX-MAFIA GARDENER: “Welcome to my completely legitimate garden.”

Grumpy Cat slowly turns its head toward him with a deeply suspicious expression.

Sound effects: soft birds, distant bees, leaves rustling, one garden sprinkler clicking rhythmically, leather jacket creaking as the gardener straightens his shoulders.

Shot 2 — 0:03–0:06

Camera: medium frontal push-in on Officer Lin at center-left.

Officer Lin smiles warmly and lifts the lid from a bamboo steamer filled with fresh dumplings. A large cloud of fragrant steam rises around his glasses.

He says cheerfully in Mandarin Chinese:

OFFICER LIN: “请大家先吃饺子，别打架。”

He gestures toward the dumplings, then raises one warning finger on “别打架.”

Sound effects: soft wooden lid knock, strong puff of steam, gentle ceramic plate clink, Officer Lin’s leather satchel buckle jingling.

Shot 3 — 0:06–0:09

Camera: medium two-shot from the opposite side of the table, with Nae in the foreground right and Duras Dacicus in the background left.

Nae immediately leans toward the dumplings, points proudly at them and declares in Romanian:

NAE: “Eu le-am făcut! Se vede după măiestrie.”

Duras slowly turns his head toward Nae, lowers his wooden sword slightly and replies in a deep Romanian voice:

DURAS DACICUS: “Minți.”

Nae’s proud smile freezes. His moustache twitches indignantly.

Sound effects: Nae’s boots scraping forward, a proud slap against his own chest, leather wrist wraps creaking as Duras tightens his grip, one short dramatic wooden sword scrape.

Shot 4 — 0:09–0:12

Camera: elegant low-angle close two-shot of Lady Florentine and Madame Gogo Chanel on the right side of the table, with the steamer blurred in the foreground.

Lady Florentine delicately lifts one dumpling with the tip of her ornate cane, inspects it as though evaluating court cuisine and says in French:

LADY FLORENTINE: “C’est rustique… mais acceptable.”

Madame Gogo Chanel leans closer, narrows her eyes at the dumpling’s folds and replies sharply in French:

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Non. Le pli est catastrophique.”

She makes a tiny disapproving gesture with one gloved hand.

Sound effects: pearl necklaces softly clicking, cane tip tapping the plate, fabric rustling, Madame Gogo Chanel’s heel tapping once against the ground.

Shot 5 — 0:12–0:15

Camera: over-the-table medium shot toward the Big Good Wolf, with Grumpy Cat large in the foreground.

The Big Good Wolf raises both hands in exasperation and asks in English:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “Are we eating them or reviewing them?”

Grumpy Cat looks directly into the camera and releases one long, irritated:

GRUMPY CAT: “Mrrrraow.”

The wolf slowly lowers his hands, apparently accepting the cat’s authority.

Sound effects: wolf claws lightly tapping the tabletop, suit fabric stretching, cat tail thumping twice against the wood, distant crow calling once.

Shot 6 — 0:15–0:18

Camera: narrow telephoto shot aimed toward the background gate, followed by a slow lateral track.

Zaches creeps out from behind the gate, hunched forward with an enormous mischievous grin. Everyone in the foreground is distracted.

He reaches one long hand toward the bamboo steamer and whispers in German:

ZACHES: “Nur eine ganz kleine Kostprobe…”

He begins sliding the entire steamer toward himself instead of taking one dumpling.

Sound effects: exaggerated quiet tiptoes, coat tails brushing the ground, faint sinister chuckle, bamboo steamer scraping slowly across the table.

Shot 7 — 0:18–0:21

Camera: extreme close-up of Grumpy Cat’s eyes, followed by a fast whip-pan to Zaches’s hand.

Grumpy Cat’s pupils narrow. Its paw shoots forward and smacks Zaches across the knuckles.

Zaches yelps and jerks backward. The steamer launches into the air, spinning above the table. Dumplings scatter in several clean, readable arcs.

ZACHES: “Aua!”

Everyone looks upward simultaneously.

Sound effects: sharp cat-paw slap, Zaches’s high-pitched yelp, bamboo lid clattering, fast airborne whooshes, several collective gasps.

Shot 8 — 0:21–0:24.5

Camera: fast left-to-right tracking shot following the falling objects, while preserving everyone’s established positions.

Three rapid visual beats occur during the same continuous shot:

Duras catches the empty bamboo steamer flat on the broad side of his wooden sword.
The Big Good Wolf catches the spinning lid on the end of his nose and goes cross-eyed trying to see it.
The shy Japanese girl calmly reaches forward with a pair of chopsticks from the table and catches the final falling dumpling without moving her feet.

She looks at the stunned group and says softly in Japanese:

SHY JAPANESE GIRL: “だいじょうぶです。”

Officer Lin beams proudly at her.

Sound effects: wooden sword swish, hollow bamboo “tok,” lid landing with a soft “bonk,” chopsticks snapping together, tiny dumpling squish, the girl’s handbag buckle gently jingling.

Shot 9 — 0:24.5–0:27.5

Camera: medium reaction shot from the right, framing Lady Florentine and Madame Gogo Chanel in the foreground with the wolf behind them.

The Big Good Wolf remains frozen with the bamboo lid balanced like an absurd round hat on his nose.

Madame Gogo Chanel studies him seriously and says in French:

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Le chapeau lui va bien.”

Lady Florentine nods with unexpected approval:

LADY FLORENTINE: “Enfin, quelqu’un d’élégant.”

The wolf stares miserably at the camera and mutters in English:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “I hate fashion.”

Sound effects: pearls clicking as both women nod, hat lid wobbling, wolf’s exhausted sigh, one quiet snicker from Nae off-screen.

Shot 10 — 0:27.5–0:30

Camera: return to the original wide composition, followed by a sudden snap zoom toward the center of the table.

Everyone turns back toward the dumplings—but the food has vanished.

Grumpy Cat now sits inside the bamboo steamer, cheeks completely full, with one final dumpling held beneath its paw.

Officer Lin’s smile disappears. He says in calm, ominous Mandarin:

OFFICER LIN: “现在真的要打架了。”

Nae immediately points at the cat and shouts in Romanian:

NAE: “Eu am știut!”

The gardener lunges protectively in front of his flower bed and yells in English:

EX-MAFIA GARDENER: “Nobody touch the chrysanthemums!”

Grumpy Cat swallows, gives a tiny unapologetic meow and places its paw firmly over the last dumpling.

End on the cat’s defiant face as everyone erupts behind it.

Sound effects: synchronized gasp, rapid chair scrape, Duras’s wooden sword lifting, wolf claws skidding, Nae’s boots stomping, ladies’ jewelry rattling, gardener’s flowerpot wobbling, final tiny cat burp followed by one dry “meow.” Hard cut to silence.

es.content:
Formato: comedia animada cinematográfica 16:9, 30 segundos, animación 2D estilizada de alta calidad con iluminación dimensional y animación facial fluida. Conserva exactamente el rostro, tipo de cuerpo, proporciones, peinado, vestuario, colores, accesorios y personalidad de cada personaje de las diez imágenes de referencia. Unifica el estilo de renderizado sin rediseñar a ningún personaje.

Ubicación: un pequeño jardín comunitario sospechosamente impecable, perteneciente al aspirante a jardinero exmafioso. Una larga mesa de madera cruza horizontalmente el centro del jardín. Un invernadero se alza en el extremo izquierdo, la puerta de entrada está centrada al fondo y los parterres de flores amarillas ocupan el lado derecho.

Posiciones espaciales fijas  
Chica japonesa tímida: extremo izquierdo, junto al final de la mesa.  
Duras Dacicus: fondo izquierdo, detrás de la mesa.  
Officer Lin: centro-izquierda, detrás de un vaporizador de bambú para dumplings.  
Grumpy Cat: sentado justo en el centro de la mesa.  
Nae: centro-derecha, frente a Officer Lin.  
Lady Florentine y Madame Gogo Chanel: sentadas juntas en el lado derecho de la mesa.  
Big Good Wolf: de pie detrás de las dos mujeres, a la derecha.  
Jardinero exmafioso: extremo derecho, junto a sus flores amarillas.  
Zaches: inicialmente oculto cerca de la puerta del fondo.

Nadie cambia de lado entre planos. Mantén una dirección de pantalla coherente y la geografía del jardín constante durante toda la escena.

Audio: sin música y sin narrador. Solo diálogo, ambiente del jardín y efectos de sonido sincronizados con precisión. El diálogo en idioma nativo debe tener pronunciación natural y sincronización labial exacta. No generes subtítulos ni ningún otro texto en pantalla; deja limpio el espacio inferior del encuadre para añadir subtítulos más tarde.

Plano 1 — 0:00–0:03

Cámara: plano general de establecimiento desde ligeramente por encima de la puerta del jardín, descendiendo lentamente en grúa hacia la mesa larga.

Los diez personajes son visibles en sus posiciones establecidas. El jardinero se yergue orgulloso junto a sus flores con las manos en los bolsillos de su chaqueta naranja. Todos los demás parecen inseguros sobre por qué han sido invitados.

El jardinero anuncia en inglés, con una respetabilidad forzada:

EX-MAFIA GARDENER: “Welcome to my completely legitimate garden.”

Grumpy Cat gira lentamente la cabeza hacia él con una expresión profundamente sospechosa.

Efectos de sonido: pájaros suaves, abejas lejanas, hojas rozando, un aspersor del jardín haciendo clic rítmicamente, la chaqueta de cuero crujiendo mientras el jardinero endereza los hombros.

Plano 2 — 0:03–0:06

Cámara: acercamiento frontal medio sobre Officer Lin en el centro-izquierda.

Officer Lin sonríe con calidez y levanta la tapa de un vaporizador de bambú lleno de dumplings frescos. Una gran nube de vapor fragante se eleva alrededor de sus gafas.

Dice alegremente en chino mandarín:

OFFICER LIN: “请大家先吃饺子，别打架。”

Señala los dumplings y luego levanta un dedo en señal de advertencia al decir “别打架”.

Efectos de sonido: golpe suave de la tapa de madera, fuerte bocanada de vapor, leve tintineo de un plato de cerámica, hebilla del bolso de cuero de Officer Lin sonando.

Plano 3 — 0:06–0:09

Cámara: plano medio de dos personajes desde el lado opuesto de la mesa, con Nae en primer plano a la derecha y Duras Dacicus en el fondo a la izquierda.

Nae se inclina de inmediato hacia los dumplings, los señala con orgullo y declara en rumano:

NAE: “Eu le-am făcut! Se vede după măiestrie.”

Duras gira lentamente la cabeza hacia Nae, baja un poco su espada de madera y responde con una voz grave en rumano:

DURAS DACICUS: “Minți.”

La sonrisa orgullosa de Nae se congela. Su bigote se contrae indignado.

Efectos de sonido: las botas de Nae arrastrándose hacia delante, una palmada orgullosa contra su propio pecho, los brazaletes de cuero crujiendo mientras Duras aprieta el agarre, un breve y dramático roce de la espada de madera.

Plano 4 — 0:09–0:12

Cámara: elegante plano corto de dos personajes en contrapicado de Lady Florentine y Madame Gogo Chanel en el lado derecho de la mesa, con el vaporizador desenfocado en primer plano.

Lady Florentine levanta delicadamente un dumpling con la punta de su bastón ornamentado, lo inspecciona como si evaluara la cocina de la corte y dice en francés:

LADY FLORENTINE: “C’est rustique… mais acceptable.”

Madame Gogo Chanel se inclina más, entorna los ojos ante los pliegues del dumpling y responde con dureza en francés:

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Non. Le pli est catastrophique.”

Hace un pequeño gesto de desaprobación con una mano enguantada.

Efectos de sonido: collares de perlas tintineando suavemente, la punta del bastón tocando el plato, roce de telas, el tacón de Madame Gogo Chanel golpeando una vez el suelo.

Plano 5 — 0:12–0:15

Cámara: plano medio por encima de la mesa hacia Big Good Wolf, con Grumpy Cat grande en primer plano.

Big Good Wolf levanta ambas manos, exasperado, y pregunta en inglés:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “Are we eating them or reviewing them?”

Grumpy Cat mira directamente a cámara y suelta un largo e irritado:

GRUMPY CAT: “Mrrrraow.”

El lobo baja lentamente las manos, aparentemente aceptando la autoridad del gato.

Efectos de sonido: garras del lobo golpeando levemente la mesa, la tela del traje tensándose, la cola del gato golpeando dos veces la madera, un cuervo lejano graznando una vez.

Plano 6 — 0:15–0:18

Cámara: plano teleobjetivo estrecho apuntando hacia la puerta del fondo, seguido de un lento desplazamiento lateral.

Zaches se desliza fuera de detrás de la puerta, encorvado hacia delante con una enorme sonrisa traviesa. Todos en primer plano están distraídos.

Extiende una mano larga hacia el vaporizador de bambú y susurra en alemán:

ZACHES: “Nur eine ganz kleine Kostprobe…”

Empieza a deslizar todo el vaporizador hacia sí en lugar de tomar solo un dumpling.

Efectos de sonido: puntillas exageradamente silenciosas, los faldones del abrigo rozando el suelo, una risa siniestra apenas audible, el vaporizador de bambú raspando lentamente sobre la mesa.

Plano 7 — 0:18–0:21

Cámara: primerísimo primer plano de los ojos de Grumpy Cat, seguido de un rápido whip-pan hacia la mano de Zaches.

Las pupilas de Grumpy Cat se estrechan. Su pata sale disparada y golpea a Zaches en los nudillos.

Zaches grita y se echa hacia atrás de golpe. El vaporizador sale lanzado por los aires, girando sobre la mesa. Los dumplings se dispersan en varios arcos limpios y legibles.

ZACHES: “Aua!”

Todos miran hacia arriba al mismo tiempo.

Efectos de sonido: bofetada seca de la pata del gato, chillido agudo de Zaches, traqueteo de la tapa de bambú, rápidos silbidos en el aire, varios jadeos colectivos.

Plano 8 — 0:21–0:24.5

Cámara: rápido travelling de izquierda a derecha siguiendo los objetos que caen, manteniendo las posiciones establecidas de todos.

Durante el mismo plano continuo ocurren tres momentos visuales rápidos:

Duras atrapa el vaporizador de bambú vacío con la parte ancha de su espada de madera.  
Big Good Wolf atrapa la tapa giratoria en la punta de la nariz y se queda bizco intentando verla.  
La chica japonesa tímida extiende con calma unos palillos desde la mesa y atrapa el último dumpling que cae sin mover los pies.

Mira al grupo atónito y dice suavemente en japonés:

SHY JAPANESE GIRL: “だいじょうぶです。”

Officer Lin le sonríe con orgullo.

Efectos de sonido: silbido de espada de madera, “tok” hueco de bambú, la tapa cayendo con un suave “bonk”, palillos cerrándose con un chasquido, pequeño aplastamiento del dumpling, la hebilla del bolso de la chica tintineando suavemente.

Plano 9 — 0:24.5–0:27.5

Cámara: plano medio de reacción desde la derecha, encuadrando a Lady Florentine y Madame Gogo Chanel en primer plano con el lobo detrás de ellas.

fr.content:
Format : comédie animée cinématographique en 16:9, 30 secondes, animation 2D stylisée de haute qualité avec éclairage dimensionnel et animation faciale fluide. Conservez exactement le visage, le type de corps, les proportions, la coiffure, le costume, les couleurs, les accessoires et la personnalité de chaque personnage des dix images de référence. Unifiez le style de rendu sans redessiner aucun personnage.

Lieu : un petit jardin communautaire d’une propreté suspecte, appartenant au jardinier ex-mafieux qui rêve d’en être un. Une longue table en bois traverse horizontalement le milieu du jardin. Une serre se trouve tout à gauche, le portail d’entrée est centré à l’arrière-plan, et des massifs de fleurs jaunes occupent le côté droit.

Positions spatiales fixes  
Shy Japanese girl : tout à gauche, à côté de l’extrémité de la table.  
Duras Dacicus : arrière-plan gauche, derrière la table.  
Officer Lin : centre-gauche, derrière un cuiseur vapeur en bambou rempli de raviolis.  
Grumpy Cat : assis directement au centre de la table.  
Nae : centre-droit, face à Officer Lin.  
Lady Florentine et Madame Gogo Chanel : assises ensemble sur le côté droit de la table.  
Big Good Wolf : debout derrière les deux femmes, à droite.  
Ex-mafia gardener : tout à droite, à côté de ses fleurs jaunes.  
Zaches : initialement dissimulé près du portail à l’arrière-plan.

Personne ne change de côté entre les plans. Maintenez une direction d’écran cohérente et une géographie du jardin constante tout au long de la scène.

Audio : pas de musique et pas de narrateur. Uniquement des dialogues, l’ambiance du jardin et des effets sonores précisément synchronisés. Les dialogues dans la langue d’origine doivent avoir une prononciation naturelle et une synchronisation labiale exacte. Ne générez pas de sous-titres ni d’autre texte à l’écran ; laissez un espace propre en bas de l’image pour l’ajout ultérieur de sous-titres.

Plan 1 — 0:00–0:03

Caméra : plan d’ensemble large depuis légèrement au-dessus du portail du jardin, avec un lent mouvement de descente vers la longue table.

Les dix personnages sont visibles dans leurs positions établies. Le jardinier se tient fièrement à côté de ses fleurs, les mains dans les poches de sa veste orange. Tous les autres semblent perplexes quant aux raisons de leur invitation.

Le jardinier annonce en anglais, avec une respectabilité forcée :

EX-MAFIA GARDENER: “Welcome to my completely legitimate garden.”

Grumpy Cat tourne lentement la tête vers lui avec une expression profondément soupçonneuse.

Effets sonores : oiseaux doux, abeilles au loin, bruissement des feuilles, un arroseur de jardin qui cliquette rythmiquement, grincement de cuir lorsque le jardinier redresse les épaules.

Plan 2 — 0:03–0:06

Caméra : travelling avant frontal moyen sur Officer Lin, au centre-gauche.

Officer Lin sourit chaleureusement et soulève le couvercle d’un cuiseur vapeur en bambou rempli de raviolis frais. Un grand nuage de vapeur parfumée s’élève autour de ses lunettes.

Il dit joyeusement en mandarin :

OFFICER LIN: “请大家先吃饺子，别打架。”

Il désigne les raviolis, puis lève un doigt d’avertissement sur “别打架.”

Effets sonores : léger choc du couvercle en bois, forte bouffée de vapeur, doux cliquetis d’une assiette en céramique, boucle de la sacoche en cuir d’Officer Lin qui tinte.

Plan 3 — 0:06–0:09

Caméra : plan moyen en deux personnages depuis le côté opposé de la table, avec Nae au premier plan à droite et Duras Dacicus à l’arrière-plan à gauche.

Nae se penche immédiatement vers les raviolis, les désigne fièrement et déclare en roumain :

NAE: “Eu le-am făcut! Se vede după măiestrie.”

Duras tourne lentement la tête vers Nae, abaisse légèrement son épée en bois et répond d’une voix grave en roumain :

DURAS DACICUS: “Minți.”

Le sourire fier de Nae se fige. Sa moustache tressaille d’indignation.

Effets sonores : bottes de Nae qui raclent vers l’avant, tape fière sur sa propre poitrine, grincement des bandes de cuir aux poignets lorsque Duras resserre sa prise, bref raclement dramatique d’une épée en bois.

Plan 4 — 0:09–0:12

Caméra : élégant gros plan en contre-plongée sur Lady Florentine et Madame Gogo Chanel, à droite de la table, avec le cuiseur vapeur flou au premier plan.

Lady Florentine soulève délicatement un ravioli avec la pointe de sa canne ornée, l’examine comme si elle évaluait une cuisine de cour et dit en français :

LADY FLORENTINE: “C’est rustique… mais acceptable.”

Madame Gogo Chanel se penche davantage, plisse les yeux sur les plis du ravioli et répond sèchement en français :

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Non. Le pli est catastrophique.”

Elle fait un minuscule geste de désapprobation d’une main gantée.

Effets sonores : colliers de perles qui s’entrechoquent doucement, pointe de canne tapotant l’assiette, froissement des tissus, talon de Madame Gogo Chanel qui tape une fois le sol.

Plan 5 — 0:12–0:15

Caméra : plan moyen au-dessus de la table vers Big Good Wolf, avec Grumpy Cat en grand au premier plan.

Big Good Wolf lève les deux mains, exaspéré, et demande en anglais :

BIG GOOD WOLF: “Are we eating them or reviewing them?”

Grumpy Cat regarde directement la caméra et pousse un long :

GRUMPY CAT: “Mrrrraow.”

Le loup abaisse lentement les mains, semblant accepter l’autorité du chat.

Effets sonores : griffes du loup tapotant légèrement le plateau de la table, tissu du costume qui se tend, queue du chat frappant deux fois le bois, cri lointain d’un corbeau.

Plan 6 — 0:15–0:18

Caméra : plan téléobjectif étroit dirigé vers le portail à l’arrière-plan, suivi d’un lent travelling latéral.

Zaches se faufile hors de derrière le portail, courbé vers l’avant avec un immense sourire malicieux. Tous les personnages au premier plan sont distraits.

Il tend une longue main vers le cuiseur vapeur en bambou et murmure en allemand :

ZACHES: “Nur eine ganz kleine Kostprobe…”

Il commence à faire glisser tout le cuiseur vers lui au lieu de prendre un seul ravioli.

Effets sonores : petits pas feutrés exagérément discrets, pans de manteau frottant le sol, léger ricanement sinistre, cuiseur vapeur en bambou qui racle lentement sur la table.

Plan 7 — 0:18–0:21

Caméra : très gros plan sur les yeux de Grumpy Cat, suivi d’un whip-pan rapide vers la main de Zaches.

Les pupilles de Grumpy Cat se rétrécissent. Sa patte jaillit et frappe Zaches sur les jointures.

Zaches pousse un cri et se recule brusquement. Le cuiseur vapeur est propulsé dans les airs, tournoyant au-dessus de la table. Les raviolis se dispersent en plusieurs arcs nets et lisibles.

ZACHES: “Aua!”

Tout le monde lève les yeux en même temps.

Effets sonores : gifle sèche de patte de chat, cri aigu de Zaches, couvercle en bambou qui claque, sifflements rapides dans l’air, plusieurs halètements collectifs.

Plan 8 — 0:21–0:24.5

Caméra : travelling rapide de gauche à droite suivant les objets en chute, tout en conservant les positions établies de chacun.

Trois temps visuels rapides se succèdent dans le même plan continu :

Duras rattrape le cuiseur vapeur en bambou vide à plat sur le large côté de son épée en bois.  
Big Good Wolf attrape le couvercle tournoyant au bout de son nez et louche en essayant de le voir.  
La shy Japanese girl tend calmement les mains avec une paire de baguettes depuis la table et attrape le dernier ravioli en chute sans bouger les pieds.

Elle regarde le groupe médusé et dit doucement en japonais :

SHY JAPANESE GIRL: “だいじょうぶです。”

Officer Lin lui sourit avec fierté.

Effets sonores : sifflement de l’épée en bois, “tok” creux du bambou, couvercle qui atterrit avec un doux “bonk”, baguettes qui claquent ensemble, petite compression de ravioli, boucle du sac à main de la jeune fille qui tinte doucement.

Plan 9 — 0:24

ja.content:
---
形式: cinematic 16:9 のアニメコメディ、30秒、高品質なスタイライズド2Dアニメーション、立体的なライティングと滑らかな表情アニメーション。10枚の参照画像にある各キャラクターの顔、体型、プロポーション、髪型、衣装、色、アクセサリー、性格を完全に維持すること。キャラクターの再デザインは行わず、レンダリングスタイルのみを統一すること。

ロケーション: 元マフィア志望の庭師が所有する、小さくて妙に完璧すぎるコミュニティガーデン。庭の中央を長い木製テーブルが横切るように配置され、左端には温室、背景中央には入口ゲート、右側には黄色い花壇が広がっている。

固定の空間配置
Shy Japanese girl: テーブルの端のそば、左端。
Duras Dacicus: 左奥、テーブルの後ろ。
Officer Lin: 中央左、竹製の点心蒸し器の後ろ。
Grumpy Cat: テーブル中央ど真ん中に座っている。
Nae: 中央右、Officer Lin の方を向いている。
Lady Florentine と Madame Gogo Chanel: テーブル右側に並んで着席。
Big Good Wolf: 右側の2人の後ろに立っている。
Ex-mafia gardener: 右端、黄色い花のそば。
Zaches: 最初は背景のゲート付近に隠れている。

誰もショットごとに左右を移動しないこと。画面方向と庭の地理関係は全編を通して一貫させること。

Audio: 音楽なし、ナレーターなし。セリフ、庭の環境音、正確なタイミングの効果音のみ。母語のセリフは自然な発音と正確なリップシンクを必須とする。字幕やその他の画面上テキストは生成しないこと。後で字幕を入れられるよう、下部フレームは空けておくこと。

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:03

Camera: 庭のゲートより少し高い位置からのワイドなエスタブリッシングショット。ゆっくりと下方へクレーンしながら長いテーブルへ寄っていく。

10人全員が、それぞれの定位置に見えている。庭師はオレンジのジャケットのポケットに手を入れ、花のそばで誇らしげに立っている。他の全員は、なぜ招かれたのか分からず戸惑っている。

庭師は英語で、無理に品位を装いながら宣言する:

EX-MAFIA GARDENER: “Welcome to my completely legitimate garden.”

Grumpy Cat は深い সন্দ疑の表情で、ゆっくりと彼の方へ頭を向ける。

Sound effects: 小鳥のさえずり、遠くのハチ、葉擦れ、庭のスプリンクラーが規則的にカチカチ鳴る音、庭師が肩を張るときのレザージャケットのきしみ。

Shot 2 — 0:03–0:06

Camera: 中央左の Officer Lin に向けた、正面からのミディアム・プッシュイン。

Officer Lin は温かく微笑み、蒸したての餃子が入った竹蒸し器のふたを持ち上げる。香り立つ湯気の大きな雲が、彼の眼鏡の周りに立ちのぼる。

彼は中国語で明るく言う:

OFFICER LIN: “请大家先吃饺子，别打架。”

彼は餃子の方を示し、最後の「别打架」で警告するように人差し指を1本立てる。

Sound effects: 木のふたが軽く当たる音、勢いよく立ちのぼる湯気、陶器の皿がやさしく触れ合う音、Officer Lin のレザーのサッチェルのバックルが鳴る音。

Shot 3 — 0:06–0:09

Camera: テーブルの反対側からのミディアム2ショット。手前右に Nae、奥左に Duras Dacicus。

Nae はすぐに餃子へ身を乗り出し、誇らしげに指差してルーマニア語で言う:

NAE: “Eu le-am făcut! Se vede după măiestrie.”

Duras はゆっくりと Nae の方へ顔を向け、木剣を少し下げ、低いルーマニア語で返す:

DURAS DACICUS: “Minți.”

Nae の誇らしげな笑みが固まる。彼の口ひげが憤慨したようにぴくりと動く。

Sound effects: Nae のブーツが前へ擦れる音、自分の胸を誇らしげに叩く音、Duras が握りを強めるときのレザーの手首巻きのきしみ、短く драмatic な木剣の擦過音。

Shot 4 — 0:09–0:12

Camera: テーブル右側での、Lady Florentine と Madame Gogo Chanel の上品なローアングル寄りのクローズ2ショット。手前には蒸し器がぼけている。

Lady Florentine は装飾的な杖の先で餃子を一つ繊細に持ち上げ、宮廷料理を品定めするように観察してフランス語で言う:

LADY FLORENTINE: “C’est rustique… mais acceptable.”

Madame Gogo Chanel は少し身を乗り出し、餃子のひだを細めた目で見つめて、鋭くフランス語で返す:

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Non. Le pli est catastrophique.”

彼女はグローブをはめた片手で、ほんの小さく不満げなジェスチャーをする。

Sound effects: パールのネックレスがやわらかく触れ合う音、杖先が皿を軽く叩く音、布擦れ、Madame Gogo Chanel のヒールが一度だけ地面を打つ音。

Shot 5 — 0:12–0:15

Camera: テーブル越しのミディアムショットで Big Good Wolf を捉える。手前には Grumpy Cat が大きく入る。

Big Good Wolf は両手を苛立たしげに上げ、英語で尋ねる:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “Are we eating them or reviewing them?”

Grumpy Cat はカメラをまっすぐ見つめ、長く苛立ったように一声:

GRUMPY CAT: “Mrrrraow.”

狼はゆっくりと両手を下ろし、どうやら猫の権威を受け入れたように見える。

Sound effects: 狼の爪がテーブルを軽く叩く音、スーツ生地が引っ張られる音、猫のしっぽが木を2回叩く音、遠くで一度だけ鳴くカラス。

Shot 6 — 0:15–0:18

Camera: 背景ゲートの方を狙った細い望遠ショット。その後、ゆっくり横移動するトラッキング。

Zaches がゲートの陰から、身をかがめて大きないたずらっぽい笑みを浮かべながら忍び出てくる。前景の全員は気を取られている。

彼は長い手を竹蒸し器へ伸ばし、ドイツ語でささやく:

ZACHES: “Nur eine ganz kleine Kostprobe…”

彼は餃子を一つ取る代わりに、蒸し器全体を自分の方へ滑らせ始める。

Sound effects: 大げさに静かな忍び足、地面をかすめるコートの裾、かすかな不気味な笑い、竹蒸し器がテーブルの上をゆっくり擦る音。

Shot 7 — 0:18–0:21

Camera: Grumpy Cat の目の極端なクローズアップ。その後、Zaches の手へ素早

ko.content:
---
형식: cinematic 16:9 animated comedy, 30 seconds, 고품질 스타일라이즈드 2D 애니메이션, 입체적인 조명과 부드러운 얼굴 애니메이션 포함. 열 장의 레퍼런스 이미지에 있는 모든 캐릭터의 정확한 얼굴, 체형, 비율, 헤어스타일, 의상, 색상, 액세서리, 성격을 그대로 유지할 것. 어떤 캐릭터도 재디자인하지 말고 렌더링 스타일만 통일할 것.

장소: 전 마피아 지망 정원사가 관리하는, 지나치게 깨끗해서 오히려 수상한 작은 커뮤니티 가든. 정원 중앙에는 긴 나무 테이블이 가로로 놓여 있다. 왼쪽 끝에는 온실이 있고, 출입문은 배경 중앙에 있으며, 오른쪽은 노란 꽃밭으로 가득하다.

고정된 공간 배치
수줍은 일본인 소녀: 맨 왼쪽, 테이블 끝 옆.
Duras Dacicus: 왼쪽 배경, 테이블 뒤.
Officer Lin: 중앙 왼쪽, 대나무 만두 찜기 뒤.
Grumpy Cat: 테이블 정중앙에 앉아 있음.
Nae: 중앙 오른쪽, Officer Lin을 마주봄.
Lady Florentine과 Madame Gogo Chanel: 테이블 오른쪽에 나란히 앉아 있음.
Big Good Wolf: 오른쪽의 두 여성 뒤에 서 있음.
전 마피아 정원사: 맨 오른쪽, 노란 꽃들 옆.
Zaches: 처음에는 배경의 문 근처에 숨어 있음.

누구도 샷 사이에서 위치를 바꾸지 않는다. 전체적으로 화면 방향과 정원 지리를 일관되게 유지할 것.

오디오: 음악 없음, 내레이션 없음. 대사, 정원 분위기음, 그리고 정확한 타이밍의 효과음만 사용. 각 언어 대사는 자연스러운 발음과 정확한 립싱크가 필요하다. 자막이나 다른 화면 텍스트는 생성하지 말고, 나중에 자막을 넣을 수 있도록 하단 프레임 공간은 깨끗하게 비워둘 것.

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:03

Camera: 정원 문보다 약간 높은 위치에서 시작하는 와이드 establishing shot, 천천히 아래로 크레인하며 긴 테이블 쪽으로 내려온다.

열 명의 캐릭터가 모두 각자의 고정된 위치에 보인다. 정원사는 주황색 재킷 주머니에 손을 넣은 채 꽃들 옆에 당당하게 서 있다. 다른 모두는 왜 초대받았는지 확신하지 못하는 표정이다.

정원사가 영어로, 억지로 점잖은 척하며 말한다:

EX-MAFIA GARDENER: “Welcome to my completely legitimate garden.”

Grumpy Cat은 매우 의심스러운 표정으로 천천히 그를 향해 고개를 돌린다.

효과음: 부드러운 새소리, 멀리서 들리는 벌 소리, 바스락거리는 잎사귀, 정원 스프링클러 하나가 규칙적으로 딸깍거리는 소리, 정원사가 어깨를 바로 세우며 가죽 재킷이 삐걱거리는 소리.

Shot 2 — 0:03–0:06

Camera: 중앙 왼쪽의 Officer Lin을 향한 정면 미디엄 푸시인.

Officer Lin은 따뜻하게 미소 지으며 갓 만든 만두가 담긴 대나무 찜기의 뚜껑을 들어 올린다. 향긋한 김이 안경 주위를 크게 감싼다.

그는 중국어 만다린으로 밝게 말한다:

OFFICER LIN: “请大家先吃饺子，别打架。”

그는 만두를 가리킨 뒤, “别打架”에서 경고하듯 손가락 하나를 들어 올린다.

효과음: 나무 뚜껑이 부드럽게 탁 하고 닿는 소리, 강하게 피어오르는 김, 도자기 접시가 살짝 부딪히는 소리, Officer Lin의 가죽 가방 버클이 짤랑거리는 소리.

Shot 3 — 0:06–0:09

Camera: 테이블 반대편에서 잡은 미디엄 투샷, 전경 오른쪽에 Nae, 배경 왼쪽에 Duras Dacicus.

Nae는 즉시 만두 쪽으로 몸을 기울이며 그것들을 자랑스럽게 가리키고 루마니아어로 선언한다:

NAE: “Eu le-am făcut! Se vede după măiestrie.”

Duras는 천천히 Nae 쪽으로 고개를 돌리고, 나무 검을 약간 내리며 낮고 굵은 루마니아어로 답한다:

DURAS DACICUS: “Minți.”

Nae의 자랑스러운 미소가 굳는다. 그의 콧수염이 분노한 듯 씰룩거린다.

효과음: Nae의 부츠가 앞으로 끌리는 소리, 자기 가슴을 자랑스럽게 탁 치는 소리, Duras가 그립을 더 세게 쥐며 가죽 손목 보호대가 삐걱거리는 소리, 짧고 극적인 나무 검 마찰음 하나.

Shot 4 — 0:09–0:12

Camera: 테이블 오른쪽의 Lady Florentine과 Madame Gogo Chanel을 우아한 로우앵글 클로즈 투샷으로 잡고, 전경에는 찜기가 흐릿하게 보인다.

Lady Florentine은 장식이 화려한 지팡이 끝으로 만두 하나를 섬세하게 들어 올려 궁정 요리를 평가하듯 살펴본 뒤 프랑스어로 말한다:

LADY FLORENTINE: “C’est rustique… mais acceptable.”

Madame Gogo Chanel은 더 가까이 몸을 기울여 만두의 주름을 가늘게 뜨고 보며 프랑스어로 날카롭게 답한다:

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Non. Le pli est catastrophique.”

그녀는 장갑 낀 손으로 아주 작은 불만의 제스처를 한다.

효과음: 진주 목걸이가 부드럽게 부딪히는 소리, 지팡이 끝이 접시를 톡 치는 소리, 옷감이 스치는 소리, Madame Gogo Chanel의 굽이 바닥을 한 번 탁 치는 소리.

Shot 5 — 0:12–0:15

Camera: 테이블 너머 미디엄 샷으로 Big Good Wolf를 향해 잡고, 전경에는 Grumpy Cat이 크게 보인다.

Big Good Wolf는 두 손을 들어 올리며 답답하다는 듯 영어로 묻는다:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “Are we eating them or reviewing them?”

Grumpy Cat은 카메라를 정면으로 바라보며 길고 짜증 섞인 소리를 낸다:

GRUMPY CAT: “Mrrrraow.”

늑대는 천천히 손을 내리며, 마치 고양이의 권위를 받아들이는 듯하다.

효과음: 늑대의 발톱이 테이블 위를 가볍게 톡톡 치는 소리, 정장 천이 팽팽해지는 소리, 고양이 꼬리가 나무를 두 번 탁 치는 소리, 멀리서 까마귀가 한 번 우는 소리.

Shot 6 — 0:15–0:18

Camera: 배경 문을 향한 좁은 텔레포토 샷, 이어서 천천히 옆으로 트래킹.

Zaches가 문 뒤에서 몸을 낮춘 채, 엄청나게 장난기 어린 미소를 지으며 슬금슬금 나온다. 전경의 모두는 다른 데 정신이 팔려 있다.

그는 길게 뻗은 손을 대나무 찜기 쪽으로 뻗으며 독일어로 속삭인다:

ZACHES: “Nur eine ganz kleine Kostprobe…”

그는 만두 하나를 집는 대신 찜기 전체를 자기 쪽으로 밀기 시작한다.

효과음: 과장되게 조용한 발끝걸음, 바닥을 스치는 코트 자락, 희미한 사악한 웃음, 대나무 찜기가 테이블 위를 천천히 긁으며 미끄러지는 소리.

Shot 7 — 0:18–0:21

Camera: Grumpy Cat의 눈을 극단적으로 클로즈업한 뒤, Zaches의 손으로 빠르게 휩팬.

Grumpy Cat의 동공이 가늘어진다. 고양이의 앞발이 번개처럼 튀어나와 Zaches의 손마디를 세게 친다.

Z

pt.content:
Você é um tradutor profissional especializado em conteúdo de IA e tecnologia criativa.

Traduza o texto a seguir para o português (Brasil).

Regras:
1. Mantenha todos os termos técnicos com precisão (por exemplo, "prompt", "cinematic", "camera pan" podem permanecer em inglês ou usar traduções consagradas no idioma de destino).
2. Mantenha o tom natural e fluente em português — não faça uma tradução palavra por palavra.
3. Preserve qualquer formatação (quebras de linha, marcadores).
4. Se o texto contiver um prompt real de Seedance/IA (instruções de geração), mantenha-o em inglês e traduza apenas o contexto/explicação ao redor.

Texto para traduzir:
---
Format: cinematic 16:9 animated comedy, 30 seconds, high-quality stylized 2D animation with dimensional lighting and fluid facial animation. Preserve the exact face, body type, proportions, hairstyle, costume, colors, accessories and personality of every character from the ten reference images. Unify the rendering style without redesigning any character.

Location: a small, suspiciously immaculate community garden belonging to the ex-mafia wannabe gardener. A long wooden table runs horizontally across the middle of the garden. A greenhouse stands on the far left, the entrance gate is centered in the background, and yellow flower beds fill the right side.

Fixed spatial positions
Shy Japanese girl: far left, beside the end of the table.
Duras Dacicus: left background, behind the table.
Officer Lin: center-left, behind a bamboo dumpling steamer.
Grumpy Cat: sitting directly in the center of the table.
Nae: center-right, facing Officer Lin.
Lady Florentine and Madame Gogo Chanel: seated together on the right side of the table.
Big Good Wolf: standing behind the two women on the right.
Ex-mafia gardener: far right, beside his yellow flowers.
Zaches: initially concealed near the background gate.

Nobody changes sides between shots. Maintain consistent screen direction and garden geography throughout.

Audio: no music and no narrator. Only dialogue, garden ambience and precisely timed sound effects. Native-language dialogue must have natural pronunciation and accurate lip synchronization. Do not generate subtitles or other on-screen text; leave clean lower-frame space for subtitles to be added later.

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:03

Camera: wide establishing shot from slightly above the garden gate, slowly craning downward toward the long table.

All ten characters are visible in their established positions. The gardener stands proudly beside his flowers with his hands in his orange jacket pockets. Everyone else looks uncertain about why they have been invited.

The gardener announces in English, with forced respectability:

EX-MAFIA GARDENER: “Welcome to my completely legitimate garden.”

Grumpy Cat slowly turns its head toward him with a deeply suspicious expression.

Sound effects: soft birds, distant bees, leaves rustling, one garden sprinkler clicking rhythmically, leather jacket creaking as the gardener straightens his shoulders.

Shot 2 — 0:03–0:06

Camera: medium frontal push-in on Officer Lin at center-left.

Officer Lin smiles warmly and lifts the lid from a bamboo steamer filled with fresh dumplings. A large cloud of fragrant steam rises around his glasses.

He says cheerfully in Mandarin Chinese:

OFFICER LIN: “请大家先吃饺子，别打架。”

He gestures toward the dumplings, then raises one warning finger on “别打架.”

Sound effects: soft wooden lid knock, strong puff of steam, gentle ceramic plate clink, Officer Lin’s leather satchel buckle jingling.

Shot 3 — 0:06–0:09

Camera: medium two-shot from the opposite side of the table, with Nae in the foreground right and Duras Dacicus in the background left.

Nae immediately leans toward the dumplings, points proudly at them and declares in Romanian:

NAE: “Eu le-am făcut! Se vede după măiestrie.”

Duras slowly turns his head toward Nae, lowers his wooden sword slightly and replies in a deep Romanian voice:

DURAS DACICUS: “Minți.”

Nae’s proud smile freezes. His moustache twitches indignantly.

Sound effects: Nae’s boots scraping forward, a proud slap against his own chest, leather wrist wraps creaking as Duras tightens his grip, one short dramatic wooden sword scrape.

Shot 4 — 0:09–0:12

Camera: elegant low-angle close two-shot of Lady Florentine and Madame Gogo Chanel on the right side of the table, with the steamer blurred in the foreground.

Lady Florentine delicately lifts one dumpling with the tip of her ornate cane, inspects it as though evaluating court cuisine and says in French:

LADY FLORENTINE: “C’est rustique… mais acceptable.”

Madame Gogo Chanel leans closer, narrows her eyes at the dumpling’s folds and replies sharply in French:

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Non. Le pli est catastrophique.”

She makes a tiny disapproving gesture with one gloved hand.

Sound effects: pearl necklaces softly clicking, cane tip tapping the plate, fabric rustling, Madame Gogo Chanel’s heel tapping once against the ground.

Shot 5 — 0:12–0:15

Camera: over-the-table medium shot toward the Big Good Wolf, with Grumpy Cat large in the foreground.

The Big Good Wolf raises both hands in exasperation and asks in English:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “Are we eating them or reviewing them?”

Grumpy Cat looks directly into the camera and releases one long, irritated:

GRUMPY CAT: “Mrrrraow.”

The wolf slowly lowers his hands, apparently accepting the cat’s authority.

Sound effects: wolf claws lightly tapping the tabletop, suit fabric stretching, cat tail thumping twice against the wood, distant crow calling once.

Shot 6 — 0:15–0:18

Camera: narrow telephoto shot aimed toward the background gate, followed by a slow lateral track.

Zaches creeps out from behind the gate, hunched forward with an enormous mischievous grin. Everyone in the foreground is distracted.

He reaches one long hand toward the bamboo steamer and whispers in German:

ZACHES: “Nur eine ganz kleine Kostprobe…”

He begins sliding the entire steamer toward himself instead of taking one dumpling.

Sound effects: exaggerated quiet tiptoes, coat tails brushing the ground, faint sinister chuckle, bamboo steamer scraping slowly across the table.

Shot 7 — 0:18–0:21

Camera: extreme close-up of Grumpy Cat’s eyes, followed by a fast whip-pan to Zaches’s hand.

Grumpy Cat’s pupils narrow. Its paw shoots forward and smacks Zaches across the knuckles.

Zaches yelps and jerks backward. The steamer launches into the air, spinning above the table. Dumplings scatter in several clean, readable arcs.

ZACHES: “Aua!”

Everyone looks upward simultaneously.

Sound effects: sharp cat-paw slap, Zaches’s high-pitched yelp, bamboo lid clattering, fast airborne whooshes, several collective gasps.

Shot 8 — 0:21–0:24.5

Camera: fast left-to-right tracking shot following the falling objects, while preserving everyone’s established positions.

Three rapid visual beats occur during the same continuous shot:

Duras catches the empty bamboo steamer flat on the broad side of his wooden sword.
The Big Good Wolf catches the spinning lid on the end of his nose and goes cross-eyed trying to see it.
The shy Japanese girl calmly reaches forward with a pair of chopsticks from the table and catches the final falling dumpling without moving her feet.

She looks at the stunned group and says softly in Japanese:

SHY JAPANESE GIRL: “だいじょうぶです。”

Officer Lin beams proudly at her.

Sound effects: wooden sword swish, hollow bamboo “tok,” lid landing with a soft “bonk,” chopsticks snapping together, tiny dumpling squish, the girl’s handbag buckle gently jingling.

Shot 9 — 0:24.5–0:27.5

Camera: medium reaction shot from the right, framing Lady Florentine and Madame Gogo Chanel in the foreground with the wolf behind them.

The Big Good Wolf remains frozen with the bamboo lid balanced like an absurd round hat on his nose.

Madame Gogo Chanel studies him seriously and says in French:

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Le chapeau lui va bien.”

Lady Florentine nods with unexpected approval:

LADY FLORENTINE: “Enfin, quelqu’un d’élégant.”

The wolf stares miserably at the camera and mutters in English:

BIG GOOD WOLF: “I hate fashion.”

Sound effects: pearls clicking as both women nod, hat lid wobbling, wolf’s exhausted sigh, one quiet snicker from Nae off-screen.

Shot 10 — 0:27.5–0:30

Camera: return to the original wide composition, followed by a sudden snap zoom toward the center of the table.

Everyone turns back toward the dumplings—but the food has vanished.

Grumpy Cat now sits inside the bamboo steamer, cheeks completely full, with one final dumpling held beneath its paw.

Officer Lin’s smile disappears. He says in calm, ominous Mandarin:

OFFICER LIN: “现在真的要打架了。”

Nae immediately points at the cat and shouts in Romanian:

NAE: “Eu am știut!”

zh.content:
格式：cinematic 16:9 动画喜剧，30 秒，高质量风格化 2D 动画，带有立体光影和流畅的面部动画。保留十张参考图中每个角色的准确脸型、体型、比例、发型、服装、颜色、配饰和性格。统一渲染风格，但不要重新设计任何角色。

地点：一个小而可疑地一尘不染的社区花园，属于那位前黑帮、立志当园丁的人。花园中间横向摆着一张长木桌。左侧最远处有一座温室，背景中央是入口大门，右侧铺满黄色花坛。

固定空间位置  
害羞的日本女孩：最左侧，桌子末端旁边。  
Duras Dacicus：左侧背景，桌子后方。  
Officer Lin：中左，竹制饺子蒸笼后方。  
Grumpy Cat：坐在桌子正中央。  
Nae：中右，面向 Officer Lin。  
Lady Florentine 和 Madame Gogo Chanel：并排坐在桌子右侧。  
Big Good Wolf：站在右侧两位女士身后。  
前黑帮园丁：最右侧，站在他的黄色花旁边。  
Zaches：起初藏在背景大门附近。

任何镜头之间都不能换边。整个过程中保持一致的屏幕方向和花园地理位置。

音频：不要音乐，不要旁白。只保留对白、花园环境音和精确时机的音效。非英语对白必须发音自然、口型同步准确。不要生成字幕或任何屏幕文字；保留干净的下方画面空间，供之后添加字幕。

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:03

Camera: 从花园大门上方略高处拍摄的 wide establishing shot，缓慢向下俯仰，朝长桌推进。

十个角色都出现在各自既定位置。园丁双手插在橙色夹克口袋里，骄傲地站在花旁。其他人都对自己为何被邀请而感到不安。

园丁用英语宣布，带着刻意的体面感：

EX-MAFIA GARDENER: “Welcome to my completely legitimate garden.”

Grumpy Cat 缓慢转头看向他，表情极度怀疑。

Sound effects: 轻柔鸟鸣、远处蜜蜂嗡嗡声、树叶沙沙作响、一个花园喷头有节奏地咔哒作响、园丁挺直肩膀时皮夹克发出吱呀声。

Shot 2 — 0:03–0:06

Camera: 对 Officer Lin 的中景正面推进镜头，位于中左。

Officer Lin 温暖地微笑，掀开装满新鲜饺子的竹蒸笼盖子。一大团香气腾腾的蒸汽在他眼镜周围升起。

他用普通话愉快地说：

OFFICER LIN: “请大家先吃饺子，别打架。”

他说着朝饺子示意，然后在“别打架”时竖起一根警告性的手指。

Sound effects: 木盖轻轻敲击声、强烈的蒸汽喷出声、瓷盘轻碰声、Officer Lin 皮质挎包扣环叮当作响。

Shot 3 — 0:06–0:09

Camera: 从桌子另一侧拍摄的中景双人镜头，Nae 在前景右侧，Duras Dacicus 在背景左侧。

Nae 立刻俯身靠向饺子，自豪地指着它们，用罗马尼亚语宣布：

NAE: “Eu le-am făcut! Se vede după măiestrie.”

Duras 缓慢转头看向 Nae，稍微放低木剑，用低沉的罗马尼亚语回答：

DURAS DACICUS: “Minți.”

Nae 自豪的笑容僵住了。他的胡子愤怒地抽动了一下。

Sound effects: Nae 的靴子向前摩擦声、他拍自己胸口的自豪一击、Duras 收紧握剑时皮质护腕吱呀作响、一次短促而戏剧化的木剑摩擦声。

Shot 4 — 0:09–0:12

Camera: 优雅的低角度近景双人镜头，拍摄桌子右侧的 Lady Florentine 和 Madame Gogo Chanel，前景中蒸笼虚化。

Lady Florentine 用她华丽手杖的尖端优雅地夹起一个饺子，像在评判宫廷菜肴一样仔细端详，然后用法语说：

LADY FLORENTINE: “C’est rustique… mais acceptable.”

Madame Gogo Chanel 俯身靠近，眯起眼看着饺子的褶皱，尖锐地用法语回应：

MADAME GOGO CHANEL: “Non. Le pli est catastrophique.”

她用戴手套的一只手做了一个极小的、不赞同的手势。

Sound effects: 珍珠项链轻轻碰撞声、手杖尖端敲击盘子的声音、布料摩擦声、Madame Gogo Chanel 的高跟鞋在地面上轻点一下。

Shot 5 — 0:12–0:15

Camera: 越过桌面的中景镜头，对准 Big Good Wolf，Grumpy Cat 在前景中占据很大画面。

Big Good Wolf 夸张地举起双手，恼火地问英语：

BIG GOOD WOLF: “Are we eating them or reviewing them?”

Grumpy Cat 直视镜头，发出一声又长又烦躁的：

GRUMPY CAT: “Mrrrraow.”

狼慢慢放下双手，似乎接受了猫的权威。

Sound effects: 狼爪轻轻敲击桌面的声音、衣服布料拉伸声、猫尾巴在木头上重重拍了两下、远处乌鸦叫了一声。

Shot 6 — 0:15–0:18

Camera: 朝背景大门方向的窄长焦镜头，随后缓慢横向移动。

Zaches 从大门后面偷偷溜出来，身体前倾，脸上挂着巨大的狡黠笑容。前景中的所有人都被分散了注意力。

他伸出一只长手朝竹蒸笼探去，用德语低声说：

ZACHES: “Nur eine ganz kleine Kostprobe…”

他开始把整个蒸笼往自己这边滑，而不是只拿一个饺子。

Sound effects: 夸张而轻的踮脚声、衣摆扫过地面的声音、若有若无的阴险窃笑、竹蒸笼缓慢刮过桌面的声音。

Shot 7 — 0:18–0:21

Camera: Grumpy Cat 眼睛的极近特写，随后快速 whip-pan 到 Zaches 的手。

Grumpy Cat 的瞳孔收缩。它的爪子猛地伸出，拍在 Zaches 的指关节上。

Zaches 惊叫一声，猛地向后缩。蒸笼被甩到空中，在桌子上方旋转。饺子以几条清晰可读的弧线散开。

ZACHES: “Aua!”

所有人同时抬头看去。

Sound effects: 猫爪清脆拍击声、Zaches 尖细的痛叫、竹盖哗啦作响、快速的空中呼啸声、几声集体倒吸气。

Shot 8 — 0:21–0:24.5

Camera: 快速从左到右跟拍下落物体，同时保持所有人既定位置不变。

同一个连续镜头中出现三个快速视觉节拍：

Duras 用木剑宽阔的一面平稳接住了空竹蒸笼。
Big Good Wolf 用鼻尖接住了旋转的蒸笼盖子，眼睛努力对成斗鸡眼去看它。
害羞的日本女孩平静地从桌上拿起一双筷子，向前伸手，在脚步不动的情况下接住了最后一个下落的饺子。

她看着惊呆的众人，轻声用日语说：

SHY JAPANESE GIRL: “だいじょうぶです。”

Officer Lin 自豪地朝她露出灿烂笑容。
